propositions: Four overlay and leaf criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) have produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic runs due to ineffective trigger vocabulary.

Deterministic pre-filter gates with audit-refined regex triggers and file_impact rules will skip criteria only when subject vocabulary is entirely absent, reducing false negatives to 84–96.5% fire rates while preserving LLM routing for fired plans.
Skip events are recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id and rule name, visible in REVIEW_RESULT sidecars for observability.
asserted-capability gate enforces conjunction: both module-ref and capability-verb text_all regex legs must match to fire; single-leg matches do not trigger routing.
T14 and removal-rationale criteria fire on file_impact paths and reasons alone, independent of plan description text matching.
Existing overlay-trigger fire/no-fire behavior for T5a, T5d, T7, T12 is preserved under the new DetGateRule table representation.
